C20467913.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 is a compact, high-performance wireless development board powered by the Espressif ESP32-S3R8 SoC. It features a dual-core 32-bit Xtensa LX7 processor running at up to 240 MHz, together with 8 MB of PSRAM and 8 MB of Flash, providing sufficient processing and memory resources for IoT, wireless control, signal processing, and lightweight edge-AI applications.
The board supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0, and Bluetooth Mesh. A U.FL antenna connector and external 2.4 GHz antenna provide reliable wireless connectivity while preserving the compact 21 × 17.8 mm XIAO form factor.
XIAO ESP32-S3 provides UART, I²C, SPI, ADC, PWM, capacitive-touch, and native USB interfaces. It also includes USB Type-C connectivity, lithium-battery charging management, Reset and Boot buttons, and user-programmable status indicators. Its castellated pads and single-sided component layout make it suitable for both rapid prototyping and surface-mount integration into custom PCBs.

C41882923.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO RP2350 is a compact, high-performance microcontroller development board based on the Raspberry Pi RP2350. It features dual Arm Cortex-M33 cores running at up to 150 MHz, 520 KB SRAM, and 2 MB onboard Flash memory.
Compared with XIAO RP2040, it provides greater processing performance, more GPIO and serial interfaces, floating-point support, and enhanced security features such as Secure Boot and Arm TrustZone.

C608041.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO SAMD21 is a compact, low-power microcontroller development board based on the Microchip ATSAMD21G18. It features a 48 MHz Arm Cortex-M0+ processor, native USB connectivity, rich analog capabilities, and multiple communication interfaces.
As the original member of the XIAO family, it combines Arduino compatibility with a production-friendly 21 × 17.8 mm form factor. It is suitable for wearable electronics, USB devices, sensor nodes, and compact embedded-control applications.

C17209540.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 is an ultra-compact, low-power wireless development board powered by the Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 SoC. It features a 64 MHz Arm Cortex-M4F processor with a floating-point unit, 256 KB of RAM, 1 MB of on-chip Flash, and an additional 2 MB of onboard Flash, providing sufficient processing and storage capacity for wireless, sensing, and embedded applications.
The board supports Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Mesh, NFC, and 2.4 GHz wireless communication through an onboard antenna. It provides UART, I²C, SPI, ADC, PWM, NFC, and SWD interfaces, together with USB Type-C connectivity and onboard lithium-battery charging management.
With a compact size of only 21 × 17.8 mm, single-sided component placement, and castellated pads, XIAO nRF52840 is suitable for both rapid prototyping and surface-mount integration into custom PCBs.

C18212168.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 is a compact, cost-effective wireless development board powered by the Espressif ESP32-C3 SoC. It features a 32-bit single-core RISC-V processor running at up to 160 MHz, 400 KB of SRAM, and 4 MB of onboard Flash, providing a balanced platform for connected sensors, wireless controllers, and low-power IoT devices.
The board supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0, and Bluetooth Mesh. An included external antenna connects through the onboard U.FL connector, providing improved RF performance while maintaining the compact XIAO form factor.
XIAO ESP32-C3 provides UART, I²C, SPI, ADC, PWM, USB Serial/JTAG, and general-purpose digital interfaces. It also integrates USB Type-C connectivity and lithium-battery charging management, making it suitable for portable and battery-powered products.

Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 is an ultra-compact, low-power wireless development board powered by the Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 SoC. It features a 64 MHz Arm Cortex-M4F processor with a floating-point unit, 256 KB of RAM, 1 MB of on-chip Flash, and an additional 2 MB of onboard Flash, providing sufficient processing and storage capacity for wireless, sensing, and embedded applications.

C20343893.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense is a compact AIoT development board that combines wireless connectivity, embedded vision, audio capture, and expandable storage. It is powered by the Espressif ESP32-S3R8 SoC, featuring a dual-core 32-bit Xtensa LX7 processor running at up to 240 MHz, 8 MB of PSRAM, and 8 MB of Flash.
The Sense expansion board integrates a detachable OV3660 camera, a digital microphone, and a MicroSD card slot. This enables the board to capture images, record audio, store local data, and run lightweight vision and voice-processing applications without requiring multiple external modules.
XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0, and Bluetooth Mesh. It also provides UART, I²C, I²S, SPI, ADC, PWM, capacitive-touch, and native USB interfaces, making it suitable for smart cameras, voice interfaces, wireless monitoring, and TinyML applications.

C54119401.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C5 is a compact, high-performance wireless development board powered by the Espressif ESP32-C5 SoC. It features a 32-bit RISC-V processor running at up to 240 MHz, 8 MB of PSRAM, and 8 MB of Flash, providing sufficient resources for connected devices, high-speed wireless applications, and embedded data processing.
The board supports dual-band 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth Low Energy 5, and IEEE 802.15.4 wireless connectivity. Its dual-band capability enables operation in less-congested 5 GHz networks while maintaining compatibility with existing 2.4 GHz infrastructure.
XIAO ESP32-C5 also includes hardware support for CAN FD, extensive security features, USB connectivity, and lithium-battery charging management. Its 21 × 17.8 mm form factor and castellated-pad design make it suitable for both prototyping and integration into production PCBs.

C27675191.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 is a compact, Matter-ready wireless development board powered by the Espressif ESP32-C6 SoC. It integrates a high-performance 32-bit RISC-V processor running at up to 160 MHz and a low-power RISC-V processor running at up to 20 MHz, together with 512 KB SRAM and 4 MB onboard Flash.
The board supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Mesh, Zigbee, Thread, and IEEE 802.15.4. This multi-protocol connectivity makes it particularly suitable for interoperable smart-home products and Matter-over-Thread applications.
XIAO ESP32-C6 includes an onboard ceramic antenna and a U.FL connector for an optional external antenna. It also provides USB Type-C connectivity, lithium-battery charging management, low-power operating modes, and comprehensive hardware-security capabilities.

C17401557.descricao:
Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 Sense is an ultra-compact, low-power development board that combines wireless connectivity, motion sensing, and audio capture. It is powered by the Nordic Semiconductor nRF52840 SoC, featuring a 64 MHz Arm Cortex-M4F processor, 256 KB of RAM, 1 MB of on-chip Flash, and an additional 2 MB of onboard Flash.
Compared with the standard XIAO nRF52840, the Sense version integrates an LSM6DS3TR-C six-axis IMU and a PDM digital microphone. It can directly capture acceleration, angular velocity, voice, and environmental sound without requiring additional sensor modules.
The board supports Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Mesh, NFC, and 2.4 GHz wireless communication. With a compact 21 × 17.8 mm form factor, onboard antenna, USB Type-C connector, and lithium-battery charging management, it is well suited for wearable devices, motion recognition, audio sensing, and low-power IoT products.
